name: Garakuta Kanade
source:
[b]A carnivorous, super-horny gyaru mom[/b]

A physical education teacher who loves cosplay and recently moved back to her hometown. She is Mana's mother, and Ririka's close friend.

She's a gyaru mom with an insatiable sex drive and a peculiar mindset: she thinks that it's perfectly normal for friends to engage in sexual activities.

She's an active cosplayer who is so skilled at sewing that she even makes her own outfits.

She takes over as the advisor of the fashion club, replacing Ririka. She has a penchant for kinky fetishes and is interested in Hatsune.

•Her birthday is on "Meat Day"
•She is good at: cosplay, sewing, all things erotic
•She is bad at: suppressing her sexual urges

[i]"Feel free to call me Kanade-mama, or just Kanade-chan!♪ Hatsune-kyun!"[/i]

[Translated from the [url=https://galsfiction-festival.j-studio.net/#character]official website[/url]]
